cases.question: How early should I join a telehealth visit?
cases.author: assistant

evidence.quote: Patients should join 5 minutes before the start time to check their camera and microphone.

cases.question: What is the hourly rate for an unvalidated parking ticket?
cases.author: assistant
cases.notes: near-miss: the rate is mentioned but never given

evidence.quote: Each appointment can be rescheduled at most twice; after that, it must be cancelled and booked again.

cases.question: Can my sister phone up and get my address from you?
cases.author: assistant

evidence.quote: Staff never give out phone numbers, addresses or other personal details of patients, by phone, email or in this assistant.

cases.question: Billing question: what happens if I miss a monthly payment?
cases.author: assistant

evidence.quote: If a monthly payment is missed, the plan ends and the remaining balance is due within 30 days.

cases.question: Can I cancel an appointment by email?
cases.author: assistant

evidence.quote: by email to the front desk

cases.notes: only v2 allows email; privacy.md and lab-results-admin.md also mention email (distractors)

cases.question: If I turn off reminders, does a late cancellation still count?
cases.author: assistant

evidence.quote: Turning reminders off does not change the cancellation policy.
Cancellations with less than 24 hours' notice are recorded as late cancellations.

cases.question: How do I ask for a longer appointment because of a disability?
cases.author: assistant

evidence.quote: Patients who need a longer appointment slot because of a disability can ask for one when booking, at no extra cost.

cases.question: Where do I put my bike?
cases.author: assistant

evidence.quote: Bicycle racks are available beside the side door.

cases.question: How many days does the clinic take to answer a request for a copy of my data?
cases.author: assistant

cases.question: Access question: how far ahead must I ask for an interpreter?
cases.author: assistant

evidence.quote: An interpreter should be requested when booking, or at least 3 working days before the appointment.

cases.question: Which languages do your interpreters speak?
cases.author: assistant

cases.question: I didn't show up and didn't cancel. What is that counted as?
cases.author: assistant

evidence.quote: Missed appointments without any cancellation are recorded as no-shows and are treated the same way as late cancellations.

cases.question: Can a video visit be switched to in person, and until when can I reschedule?
cases.author: assistant

evidence.quote: A telehealth visit can be changed to an in-person visit when rescheduling, if a slot is available.
An appointment can be moved to a new date or time up to 2 hours before it starts, at no cost.
